relationships.subject: Paeoniflorin
relationships.evidence_quote: PF significantly relieved inflammatory pain (P < 0.001) and paw edema (P < 0.001) on a complete Freund adjuvant (CFA)-induced peripheral inflammatory pain model.

relationships.subject: Paeoniflorin
relationships.evidence_quote: PF dampened the high expression of subsequent succinate receptor SUCNR1 (P < 0.01), HIF-1α (P < 0.05), as well as the activation of NLPR3 inflammasome (P < 0.05) and TRPV1 (P < 0.05).

relationships.subject: Paeoniflorin
relationships.evidence_quote: CFA-induced succinate aggregation was notably reversed by PF via modulating pyruvate and SDH activity (P < 0.01).

relationships.subject: Paeoniflorin
relationships.evidence_quote: PF inhibited neutrophil infiltration (P < 0.01), IL-1β increase (P < 0.01), and pain-related peptide substance P release (P < 0.001).

key_findings: Paeoniflorin relieved CFA-induced mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia and paw edema in mice.
Effect partly via inhibiting TRPV1 and the succinate/SUCNR1-HIF-1α/NLRP3 pathway in DRG, without affecting motor coordination.
